const data = items[0].json;

const report = `
# 📊 Automated Cost Analysis Report

📅 Generated At: ${data.generatedAt}

---

# 🧾 Executive Summary

| Platform | Usage |
|---|---|
| Make.com Operations Used | ${data.executiveSummary.make.operationsUsed} |
| Make.com Credits Used | ${data.executiveSummary.make.creditsUsed} |
| Voiceflow AI Operations | ${data.executiveSummary.voiceflow.aiOperations} |
| Voiceflow Interactions | ${data.executiveSummary.voiceflow.interactions} |
| Vapi Total Calls | ${data.executiveSummary.vapi.totalCalls} |
| Vapi Total Cost | $${data.executiveSummary.vapi.totalCost} |
| Twilio Total Cost | $${data.executiveSummary.twilio.totalCost} |
| Twilio Active Categories | ${data.executiveSummary.twilio.activeCategoryCount} |

---

# ⚙️ Make.com Usage

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Plan | ${data.makeReport.plan} |
| Operations Remaining | ${data.makeReport.operationsRemaining} |
| Credits Remaining | ${data.makeReport.creditsRemaining} |
| Active Scenarios | ${data.makeReport.activeScenarios} |

---

# 🤖 Voiceflow Usage

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Most Used Model | ${data.voiceflowReport.mostUsedModel} |
| Highest Usage Day | ${data.voiceflowReport.highestUsageDay} |
| Total AI Operations | ${data.executiveSummary.voiceflow.aiOperations} |
| Total Interactions | ${data.executiveSummary.voiceflow.interactions} |

---

# 📞 Vapi Call Analytics

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Total Calls | ${data.executiveSummary.vapi.totalCalls} |
| Average Call Duration | ${data.vapiReport.avgCallDuration} mins |
| Total Cost | $${data.executiveSummary.vapi.totalCost} |

## 💰 Vapi Cost Breakdown

| Cost Type | Amount |
|---|---|
| LLM Cost | $${data.vapiReport.costBreakdown.llmCost} |
| STT Cost | $${data.vapiReport.costBreakdown.sttCost} |
| TTS Cost | $${data.vapiReport.costBreakdown.ttsCost} |
| Transport Cost | $${data.vapiReport.costBreakdown.transportCost} |
| Vapi Platform Cost | $${data.vapiReport.costBreakdown.vapiCost} |

---

# 📱 Twilio Usage

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Total Cost | $${data.twilioReport.totalCost} |
| Currency | ${data.twilioReport.currency.toUpperCase()} |
| Active Billed Categories | ${data.twilioReport.activeCategoryCount} |

## 💰 Twilio Cost by Service

| Service | Cost |
|---|---|
| SMS | $${data.twilioReport.costByService.sms} |
| Voice | $${data.twilioReport.costByService.voice} |
| WhatsApp | $${data.twilioReport.costByService.whatsapp} |
| Wireless | $${data.twilioReport.costByService.wireless} |
| Video | $${data.twilioReport.costByService.video} |
| Other | $${data.twilioReport.costByService.other} |

${data.twilioReport.categoryBreakdown.length > 0
  ? `## 📋 Twilio Line Items\n\n| Category | Description | Cost | Usage |\n|---|---|---|---|\n` +
    data.twilioReport.categoryBreakdown
      .map(r => `| ${r.category} | ${r.description} | $${r.cost} | ${r.usage} ${r.usageUnit} |`)
      .join("\n")
  : "## 📋 Twilio Line Items\n\nNo billable usage recorded for this period."
}

---

# 📝 Notes

- Voiceflow usage represents event counts, not direct billing.
- Make.com credits are calculated from centicredits / 100.
- n8n is self-hosted, therefore no platform billing cost.
- Vapi costs are actual monetary usage values.
- Twilio shows only categories with non-zero cost. All costs in USD.

`;

return [
  {
    json: {
      report
    }
  }
];
